It measures 84 cm in length and 83.5 cm in width.　　Su Ci was a native of Fufeng, Shaanxi Province, and served in the Western Wei Dynasty, the Northern Zhou Dynasty, and the Sui Dynasty. He died in Jiaozhou (present-day north-central Vietnam) in the first year of the reign of Sui Emperor Wendi (601), and was buried in Tongzhou (present-day Dali County, Shaanxi) on the seventh day of the third year of reign (603). The original title is "The epitaph of Sui's ambassador, the son of the prince, the right concubine, Hongji, Jiang, Pious, Rao, Yuan, and the military of the seven states, the governor of Hongzhou, An Pingan.
